gloss: incorrect kanji conversion; typo from input method

definitions.gloss: incorrect kanji conversion; input method error
definitions.explanation: When a Japanese input method converts typed kana into the wrong kanji. A very common occurrence in digital communication that can lead to humorous or embarrassing mistakes.

examples.japanese: {誤変換|ごへんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づかなかった。
examples.english: I didn't notice the incorrect conversion.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誤変換|ごへんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{恥|は}ずかしかった→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧。
examples.english: There was a kanji conversion error in my email and I was embarrassed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}ったら→送る：00742_okuru⟧{誤変換|ごへんかん}⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧で、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|わら}われた→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: I sent a message in a hurry and it was full of conversion errors, and the other person laughed at me.

notes:
Composed of {誤|ご} (error, mistake) + ⟦{変換|へんかん}→変換：12085_henkan⟧ (conversion). A modern word deeply tied to Japanese digital literacy. Because Japanese is typed by entering kana and then selecting the correct kanji from conversion candidates, picking the wrong candidate produces a {誤変換|ごへんかん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誤変換|ごへんかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to convert to the wrong kanji
- {誤変換|ごへんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づく: to notice a conversion error
- {誤変換|ごへんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have many conversion errors
- {誤変換|ごへんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す: to fix a conversion error

CULTURAL NOTE:
Funny {誤変換|ごへんかん} examples are a popular topic on Japanese social media and have been compiled into books. Some conversion errors produce unintentionally amusing or inappropriate results.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{変換|へんかん}→変換：12085_henkan⟧: conversion — the base word
- {予測変換|よそくへんかん}: predictive conversion — the autocomplete feature of input methods
- ⟦{誤字|ごじ}→誤字：16131_goji⟧: typo, wrong character — a broader term for character errors
